name: Ray J
notes: Knockout/Koch soloist working Southern 808 R&B with Bay and Atlanta features, 2005–2008. The research gives "64–98 straight/half-time mix" and specifies the switch: "the clap on beat 3 at the low tempos and on 2&4 at 98". Three of the four sourced tempos are at or below 85, so the half-time half is the base with `halfTime` true and a `halftime_3` snare. Three drum deltas: "808 kick and clap" with `lockTo808` at 0.6 and syncopation 0.5, a clap stacked within 2 ms on a dead-flat grid, and "808 maraca/hat on offbeats, triplet percussion fills" — an offbeat shaker/conga bed at three to six hits a bar plus a hat roll vocabulary weighted onto `16T` and `32T` at 0.2 per bar, which is where the triplet fills live. This is a true 808 model: "808 sub with a slide into the root, long decay, prominent" is the whole low end, so `drums.bass808` takes role `bassline` and there is no `bassline` block. Harmony is "single- or two-chord minor beds with a bell or synth-string riff", so the single-chord family shares top weight. "Light tenor with falsetto, chant hooks, low note-density" is the 2–6 density, the empty-bar bias and the 3–5 pitch motif. ⚠ Confidence is **low**: the research rates the entry medium-low and marks the key claim `[LOW-CONF]`. ⚠ Every velocity, density and portamento number is INFERRED, and the 808-R&B drum grammar is sourced at tutorial level for the sub-lane rather than for this name. ⚠ `session.keys` is INFERRED: the entry's Keys line gives "minor-mode two-chord vamps [LOW-CONF]" and enumerates no tonic, so the values here and their weights are this author's reading of that line. ⚠ **`chords.harmonicRhythm` re-weighted (2026-08-17, harmony variety floor).** The entry gives the one-chord and the two-chord bed equal billing — "single- or two-chord minor beds with a bell or synth-string riff" — and the engine's `vamp` value is *one* chord held for the whole clip (`generators::chords`: "One chord for the whole pattern"), so a `vamp` weight of 6-of-8 made the two-chord half of that sentence almost unreachable. `vamp` keeps the top weight; the two-chord reading is now reachable at both rates. ⚠ The split between those two rates is **INFERRED** — the entry names the device, not its rate. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 937/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.16 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "single- or two-chord minor beds with a bell or synth-string riff; light tenor with falsetto, chant hooks, low note-density.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
